dedupe_keys.name: donnee secheresse vigieau france drought water use restriction orders

description: The French national dataset of drought restrictions on water use. The data.gouv.fr page says that when water runs short in low-flow periods, prefects restrict or suspend water uses under the environment code, and that this dataset, extracted from VigiEau Admin, lists the prefectoral restriction orders with the severity level they apply to one or more zones, with a link to each order's PDF in the CSV; the current year's orders are in the main file and past years are archived year by year. Files are free downloads. Coverage is France by restriction zone. Caveats: the data are indicative and come from department services, as the page says, and the licence was not shown in the part read. For simulation it gives dated limits on irrigation and other water uses during droughts, to model farm, industry and energy cooling constraints. A related catalogue record is the European Drought Observatory combined drought indicator.
